audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike and whys[5] both attributed Malphite's spike to Iceborn Gauntlet giving 'a zone slow on every auto'.
audit.why: The kits carry no item data, so the item name is unverifiable, but the real mechanism is in Riot's text: Ground Slam 'deals magic damage based on his Armor'. Every armour item he buys is a damage item. That is the spike, and it is checkable.
audit.corrected: Both lines now name Ground Slam's armour scaling instead of an item effect.

audit.whatIsWrong: Granite Shield was called 'his passive shield' with no size, Thunderclap was described only as 'W armor-empowered autos', and Fury of the North's slow immunity was implied rather than stated.
audit.why: Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his maximum health and recharges out of combat. Thunderclap (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) is an auto-attack reset whose follow-up attacks create aftershocks and apply on-hit. Fury of the North grants armour, magic resist AND immunity to slows out of combat, which is precisely why Seismic Shard's move-speed steal does nothing to you until he lands his first hit. Seismic Shard is 625 range on a flat 8s; Arctic Assault charges 650.
audit.corrected: Shield size, Thunderclap's reset, the two ranges and the slow-immunity window are now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Unstoppable Force as matchup-defining but gave no number for it or for anything else.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s; Glacial Prison is 120/105/90s. Your ultimate is shorter at every rank, which is a concrete reason to trade ults at objectives. Seismic Shard is a flat 8s and Ground Slam a flat 7s.
audit.corrected: All four numbers now present, with the ult-differential conclusion drawn.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is Malphite's spike — he gains armor, a zone slow on every auto, and his trade pattern becomes far more punishing; respect this window.
edits.after: His first armour item is the spike: Ground Slam's damage is based on his armour, so every point of defence he buys also hits you harder. Respect it.

edits.before: Malphite's Q poke strips your Fury of the North bonus repeatedly and his move-speed steal keeps him safely outside Arctic Assault range — the trade pattern favors him in these neutral levels.
edits.after: Seismic Shard is 625 range on a flat 8s and steals your move speed, keeping him outside Arctic Assault's 650 charge — though Frost Armor leaves you slow-immune until his first hit.

notes: Mirror reused from audits/top/malphite__sejuani.json rather than re-derived: the level chart already matches it inversely, so I changed nothing there. Two derived-flag misfires confirmed and deliberately NOT written: (1) the kit flags 'grounding' on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam, but Riot's descriptions for both say only slow / attack-speed reduction, so nothing on this page claims Arctic Assault can be denied; the mirror reached the same conclusion independently. (2) _missing-interactions says 'Malphite bypasses stacking resistances (Granite Shield (P))' — Granite Shield is a shield sized off HIS maximum health, not damage that ignores your resistances, so that headline is a percentHealth-flag misfire and I did not act on it.
